Now comes the grading part, here sir can be unpredictable sometimes. The reason is until midterm he will give you a lot of marks, even if your mcq gets wrong but you wrote justification, you will end up with half marks and don’t lose it. comment:
MAT361 -> Ads1 Sir is a good faculty. His classes are mostly dull because he jokes a lot, most of which are lame, I would say. Although I could understand what he taught, I didn't like his way of teaching. He doesn't teach the theoretical stuff, which is rather essential if you are planning to do CSE445 and CSE465 in the future. So, I would advise you to learn those by yourself.
If you just want a good grade, attend all his classes and note his lectures correctly. In the course outline, you will find a page containing the name of the exercises and the question numbers associated with each exercise. Make sure you practice those after each class and before the exam. He might or might not curve depending on the overall performance of the section. However, it's very much possible to score 95+ marks easily if you are regular and hardworking.
Overall, this course is easy, and since Ads1 Sir is chill, you will barely face any difficulties. However, it's necessary to be regular.
